services.name: Brand Visibility setup and baseline
services.scope: Configure the agreed monitoring portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages), validate access for up to 10 pilot users, confirm the delivery-network setup and register CDN log forwarding in Brand Visibility and confirm the logs arrive once the log-forwarding job is active in the Client's CDN console, and record one baseline for the agreed prompts and three competitors.

source.title: Experience League: Brands Management

services.template_deliverable: Configured monitoring, CDN log forwarding enabled with agentic and referral traffic flowing, baseline visibility/citation report and prioritized initial opportunities.
services.template_acceptance: Pilot users can access the workspace, CDN logs are arriving, and the baseline records the agreed prompts, engines, market and measurement dates.
services.template_assumptions: An approved prompt plan and supported workspace are available. The log-forwarding job in the Client's CDN console is often the longest item; the partner confirms its date in week one and starts the strategy and prompt work before it is live. The prompt count is the service scope. Crawler access is requested once per site, here: Adobe's scanner (Spacecat/1.0, which Sites Optimizer also uses) and the AI crawlers in robots.txt and bot rules. The edge-optimization user agent is allowed by whichever service sets up the edge route.
services.template_exclusions: CMS changes, custom data pipelines, cross-product integration and work for additional monitoring portfolios.
services.template_basis: One baseline package for one workspace and domain, with up to 10 pilot users; the prompts and markets set its planning band.
product_facts: Brand Visibility measures how your brand appears in AI-generated answers, recommends content changes and tracks how that performance changes over time.
Brand Visibility measures how your brand appears in AI-generated answers.

Brand Visibility runs the prompts you choose on a recurring basis across the AI platforms it supports and records how your brand appears in each answer and how that changes over time. It measures the prompts you monitor: the questions people put to AI assistants themselves are not disclosed by the platforms.
Adobe's Brand Presence page lists ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini and Perplexity as supported.

Its AI Visibility view opens the full AI answer behind a prompt: the response text, whether your brand was mentioned, which other brands were mentioned, whether your site was cited and the source URLs behind the answer.

The dashboards report the percentage of prompts where your brand is mentioned, how often your website is used as a source, share of voice and sentiment, and compare you with the other brands you choose to track in each market.

services.name: Monthly prompt and performance review
services.scope: Maintain the prompt portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages) and three competitors; review up to five prompt changes, read the Impact Measurement Engine's results for deployment pilots, prioritize up to 10 actions, and hold one Client review using five business measures.

source.title: Experience League: Prompts management

services.template_deliverable: Prompt change log (a stable trend cohort kept apart from new discovery prompts, with market, language, engine and configuration changes recorded), visibility and citation trends reported as movement against named peers with sampling limits noted, a prioritized optimization backlog and an outcome report.
services.template_acceptance: The report identifies measurement changes, actual results, action owners and agreed next decisions. It keeps visibility, AI-agent activity and AI-referred visits and conversions as separate measures and claims business impact only from a tested comparison.
services.template_assumptions: A working baseline and existing analytics reports are available. Stable prompt cohorts support comparison. Additional domain or market coverage is explicitly scoped. Brand Visibility runs the tracked prompts, reports visibility and citations and lists opportunities on its own; these hours cover the judgment around it: which prompts to keep, add or retire, what the results mean for the Client, which actions come first, and the Client review. This is the one monthly readout. Where Sites Optimizer's monthly fixes are in scope, it includes their search results, and they produce no separate report. Edge fixes chosen here go live only where an edge route is in place; otherwise they are listed for a pilot or as change requests. Findings that need a change to the site itself go to Sites Optimizer's monthly fixes where those are in scope, and otherwise to the Client's web team.
services.template_exclusions: Content production, code changes, outreach, new analytics implementation and duplicate reporting in an integration or separate test package.
services.template_basis: One monthly review package for one brand and domain; the prompts and markets set its planning band.

services.name: Content Analytics readiness and prerequisites

services.adobe_quote: You have allow-listed the User Agent and IP address for the featurization service that is used in Content Analytics.

source.title: Experience League: Configure Content Analytics

product_facts: Content Analytics shows how your content affects the key performance indicators you have defined. It breaks content down into components and attributes, so you can analyze what content, and what attributes of that content, drive business results.
Content Analytics measures which content, and which attributes of that content, drive business results.

We would set Content Analytics up with Adobe's guided configuration wizard, which covers all the steps required. The Experience Platform Web or Mobile SDK then records impressions and interactions with your content, and data collection starts once the Tags property is published.

Reporting is in Customer Journey Analytics, where a Workspace template gives you a pre-populated project with content insights: which assets are receiving impressions and where, and engagement such as the average click through rate for assets with certain attributes.
Access is governed through data views: a user or group of users reaches Content Analytics only through the data views that are configured for it.

source.title: Experience League: Publish CJA audiences

services.template_deliverable: Audience definitions, the published audiences, an activation plan with owners, and the measures to review in the monthly report.
services.template_acceptance: The audiences populate in Real-Time Customer Profile with the agreed definitions, and the Client approves the activation plan.
services.template_assumptions: The Client licenses Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer, because CJA audience publishing to Real-Time Customer Profile needs one of them; CJA alone does not license Profile Service. The Client has licensed CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (derived fields are not included in CJA Foundation). A CJA administrator, who gets the Audience Publishing permission automatically, also has Experience Platform's Manage Profiles permission. The Person ID in the CJA connection is agreed: CJA sends it as each audience member's primary identity, one identity per person. Channel owners confirm identity, consent and the intended use, and take part. Any downstream destination is already configured and licensed in Experience Platform and is activated there after the audience is published. The source datasets don't need to be enabled for Profile. Audiences come from AI-referred visitors in the Client's existing web data, found with a derived field on AI referring domains; the Brand Visibility dataset holds only aggregate AI-agent activity by URL and host, with no personal identifiers, and is not needed for these audiences.
services.template_exclusions: New destinations or channels, campaign production, personalization builds and audience work in other tools.
services.template_basis: One CJA data view: up to five audiences from AI-referred visitors, published to Real-Time Customer Profile, with an activation plan.
product_facts: Customer Journey Analytics brings Analysis Workspace to the data in Adobe Experience Platform, so journeys can be analyzed across channels in one reporting view.
Customer Journey Analytics measures the results across channels.

In Customer Journey Analytics your data can be viewed and analyzed in sequence across channels: data from your call center, point-of-sale systems and online properties is combined into a single reporting view.

Results are measured in Customer Journey Analytics, used as the reporting source for Target's A/B activities: its Experimentation panel compares the variations and reports each one's lift over the baseline, and the confidence in it, on the success metrics you choose.

product_facts: Real-Time CDP Collaboration lets you discover, activate and measure high-value audiences with advertisers and publishers, without relying on third-party cookies, in a privacy-centric, centralized environment.
Real-Time CDP Collaboration matches your audiences with those of advertisers and publishers for discovery, activation and measurement.

Setup starts with access roles, which determine what your users can see and do. We would define your account's role, provide your branding assets, configure the match keys that align audiences across connections and select the consent mode that determines which profiles are eligible.

Work with each collaborator runs in projects: audience overlap calculations, discovering relevant audiences, activating audiences and measuring campaign performance. You see the overlap percentages and the number of overlapping identities between your audiences and theirs, and campaign performance in simplified and customizable reports.

Embedded controls guide the responsible use of audience data at every step of your workflows, and a consent mode of opt-in, opt-out or none determines which profiles are eligible to be included in connections.

product_facts: Adobe Commerce is Adobe's B2B and B2C commerce platform for digital commerce experiences across online and physical spaces. Its Admin gives your team marketing, search engine optimization and product management tools.
Adobe Commerce runs the store: products, promotions and orders are managed in its Admin.

We would follow Adobe's implementation playbook for Commerce projects, which sets out methodologies and best practices from the early stages of project scoping through development, integrations and deployment to ongoing support.

For business buyers, Adobe Commerce B2B accommodates companies with complex organizational structures and multiple users with various roles and levels of purchasing permission. Shared catalogs set custom prices per product for different companies.

Live Search replaces the standard search in Adobe Commerce. Product Recommendations use Adobe AI and machine learning, trained on aggregated shopper behavior and catalog data, to deliver personalized recommendations on the storefront.

The Data Connection extension connects your Adobe Commerce web instance to Adobe Experience Platform and the Edge Network. It collects behavioral storefront data from the browser, back office data from the Commerce servers and profile data.

Asset settings give you control over how people share company-owned assets externally: a system administrator can restrict sharing features so that sensitive content reaches only appropriate external recipients.

services.scope: Define two bounded Coworker Chat workflows, required inputs/outputs, success measures and the responsibility split between Adobe, the Client and the partner.

source.title: Experience League: Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker

services.template_deliverable: Approved workflow briefs, application/context inventory and implementation assumptions.
services.template_acceptance: The Client approves both workflows, success measures and responsibilities before configuration begins.
services.template_assumptions: The Client provides application owners and an Adobe onboarding contact. Pilot users are a training scope, not a software seat limit.
services.template_exclusions: Adobe-owned provisioning, new application implementation, enterprise security redesign and discovery already covered by another selected service.
services.template_basis: One team of up to 10 pilot users; two workshops and two workflows.
product_facts: Coworker is Adobe's AI-powered teammate for customer experience and marketing workflows. You describe a goal in plain language, and it plans the work, executes it across your Adobe and connected systems, validates the results and brings the finished work back for your approval.
Coworker lets your teams ask for insights, content and actions across your Adobe applications in natural language.

We would tailor Coworker to the way your teams work with skills: reusable playbooks that standardize common workflows, reporting methods and analysis approaches, so nobody has to explain the same process again.

You keep control through approval gates, permissions inherited from your Adobe organization, checks before actions run and an audit trail. Skills do not store customer data: data access stays governed through your connected Adobe applications, permissions and organizational controls.
Coworker acts across Adobe and external systems through governed access, using built-in connectors or your own. An external tool or service is connected by adding it as a server.

product_facts: Coworker is Adobe's AI-powered teammate for customer experience and marketing workflows. You describe a goal in plain language, and it plans the work, executes it across your Adobe and connected systems, validates the results and brings the finished work back for your approval.
Coworker lets your teams ask for insights, content and actions across your Adobe applications in natural language.

We would tailor Coworker to the way your teams work with skills: reusable playbooks that standardize common workflows, reporting methods and analysis approaches, so nobody has to explain the same process again.
